content:
Following the popularity of the #Geographic locality stream, we created a community map on the community information page of the Lean prover community website. If you want to appear on this map, you simply need to go to your Zulip profile and input geographic coordinates there. The screenshots below will help you find your Zulip profile if needed (assuming you use the Zulip website on a large screen). First you need to go to the upper-right corner, above the user list, and click on your avatar icon:
image.png

Then an edit button is hidden near the top:
image.png

If you need help to get your coordinates you can right-click on your location on the map to get a pop-up indicating the corresponding coordinates.

This is also a good opportunity to fill in more information on you Zulip profile if you want to. The GitHub login is especially convenient if you plan to contribute to a community project such as Mathlib or Std4. Of course all this is completely optional.
If you added your website to your profile earlier, you may need to do it again; we had to reset that field to allow for longer URLs.

Now might be a good time to remind everyone that we have a community map. It can be helpful for finding nearby members of the community.

If you would like to appear, you just need to add geographic coordinates to your Zulip account (see Patrick's instructions above). Obviously totally optional; many people will prefer not to appear and that is completely fine.
Another year, another reminder about the above :point_up: for anyone who wants to show up on the community map :-)
